In a noisy 30x30 grid, find embedded axis-aligned, perfectly uniform solid-color rectangular patches and recolor their cells to 4. Everything else is unchanged. The embedded rectangles vary in their original color and location; they are not limited to one color or one region of the grid.

- Demo 1: recolored uniform 8 rectangle at rows 3-8, cols 5-10 (1-based, 6x6); uniform 2 rectangle rows 3-8, cols 21-27 (6x7); uniform 3 rectangle rows 13-17, cols 23-27 (5x5); uniform 1 rectangle rows 18-23, cols 11-17 (6x7). Output color for all =4.
